readerCopy.summary: When a rule keeps asking you to violate a boundary you already know is non-negotiable, compliance starts costing more than refusal.
readerCopy.body: When a rule keeps asking you to violate a boundary you already know is non-negotiable, compliance starts costing more than refusal. When Saturn squares Lilith, duty and authority collide with the part of you that is no longer willing to cooperate at your own expense. What looks like defiance from the outside may simply be the point where keeping the peace has become more damaging than dealing with the fallout of saying no. At some point, the consequence of refusing becomes easier to live with than the consequence of abandoning yourself again.
